en.headline: School bus hits cyclist in Ping Shan; woman in 40s hospitalised
en.dek: A female cyclist was knocked unconscious after being struck by a school bus turning into Ping Kwai Road on Friday afternoon and was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: A school bus collided with a bicycle on Ping Kwai Road in Ping Shan, Yuen Long, at about 4.50pm on Friday, leaving a woman in her 40s injured.

Police said the bus was turning from Castle Peak Road into Ping Kwai Road when its right front struck the cyclist who was crossing. The woman lost consciousness at the scene but was found to have a pulse and was breathing when ambulance officers arrived. She was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital.

The school bus was carrying students at the time. The children were later transferred to other vehicles to continue their journeys. The bus sustained damage to its front and a cracked windscreen. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 屏山屏葵路校巴撞單車 女騎手一度昏迷送院
zh.dek: 周五下午約4時50分，一輛校巴由青山公路轉入屏葵路時撞倒一名騎單車過路的40多歲女子，傷者一度昏迷，送屯門醫院治理。
body: 警方接報，今午約4時50分，一輛載有學童的校巴由青山公路屏山段轉入屏葵路時，右邊車頭撞倒一名騎單車過路的女子。
女事主年約40多歲，倒地後陷入昏迷，救護員到場時發現她仍有呼吸及脈搏，隨即送往屯門醫院治理。據報她頭部流血，其後恢復清醒。
涉事校巴擋風玻璃破裂，右邊車頭凹陷。車上學童其後由其他校巴接載離開。警方正調查意外原因。
